title: transit: GC never deletes articles row or msgid_map entry
description:
## Problem
gc_executor.rs calls pin_client.unpin() but never deletes the row from the articles table or the msgid_map. After GC:
1. The article is removed from IPFS but the articles row persists — so on every subsequent GC run the same CID is selected as a candidate and unpin() is called again (repeatedly calling unpin on already-absent content).
2. The msgid_map entry persists — future ingestion of the same article (e.g. from a peer that still has it) is rejected as 435 Duplicate even though the content is gone, permanently preventing re-ingestion.

## Acceptance criteria
- On successful unpin, DELETE FROM articles WHERE cid = ? and DELETE FROM msgid_map WHERE cid = ? in the same DB transaction
- Test: after GC, the article row is absent, the msgid_map entry is absent, and re-ingesting the same message-id succeeds
